# Z-Flow - Digitalization Partner Berlin
# Process Automation, Custom Software & AI Integration

## Who We Are
Z-Flow is a digitalization partner based in Berlin, Germany. We understand your business process first, then build the right solution — whether that's automation, custom software, or AI.

Founded by Mahmoud Sheikh Alard. 5+ years of process mapping experience in Germany, now powered by AI-driven engineering. We serve startups, SMEs, and the German Mittelstand.

## Our Approach: Process First
Every engagement starts with understanding how your business actually works:
1. **Process Audit** — We map your workflows, find bottlenecks, understand what works
2. **Solution Design** — We choose the right approach based on the process map
3. **Build** — Agile development in weekly sprints with regular demos
4. **Launch & Handover** — Full documentation, training, your code. No vendor lock-in.

## Our Services

### Process Automation
Your team is spending hours on tasks a machine could handle in seconds. We map the process, find the bottlenecks, and automate what matters.
- **Platforms**: n8n (self-hosted or cloud), Make.com
- **Capabilities**: API integrations, webhooks, data sync, CRM automation, lead management, invoice automation
- **GDPR compliant**: Self-hosted n8n setups available
- **Timeline**: 1-3 weeks
- **Price**: From €3,000

### MVP / Custom Software Development
You have a business idea but no product yet. We build your MVP in weeks — functional enough to win users, clean enough to scale.
- **Tech stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase
- **What's included**: Web app, responsive design, user authentication, backend, deployment, documentation
- **Timeline**: 4-8 weeks
- **Price**: From €15,000 (fixed price)

### AI for Business / Company Brain
Your company has years of knowledge trapped in documents, emails, and people's heads. We build AI systems that capture this knowledge and put it to work.
- **Technologies**: OpenAI API, Claude API, LangChain, Vector Databases, RAG Pipelines, n8n + AI
- **Use cases**: Company knowledge bases, internal AI assistants for employees, chatbots trained on your data, document intelligence, intelligent automation
- **Approach**: Process-first, human-in-the-loop, privacy-first

### Training & Workshops
Learn to build and maintain automation and no-code solutions yourself.
- **Topics**: n8n, Make.com, WeWeb, Xano, No-Code stack
- **Format**: Remote or on-site, half-day to multi-day
- **Price**: From €1,500

## Technologies We Use
- **Automation**: n8n, Make.com
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, WeWeb
- **Backend**: Supabase, Xano, Node.js
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Airtable
- **AI**: OpenAI, Claude, 11Labs
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## Selected Projects
- **WeProspectify** — B2B sales prospecting SaaS (Next.js, Supabase, n8n, OpenAI)
- **Layovr** — Airport passenger experience platform (Next.js, Supabase)
- **AI Video Generation** — Automated marketing video pipeline (n8n, OpenAI, 11Labs)
- **AI Voice Agent** — 24/7 customer support voice agent (n8n, OpenAI)
- **Lead Generation Pipeline** — 14 interconnected workflows (n8n, Make.com, Airtable)
- **Automated Invoicing** — End-to-end invoice processing (n8n, Airtable)
- **Volunteer Management** — Platform for community organizations (WeWeb, Xano)
